problems.problem: The 'one thicker hard-edge ring' has regenerated as a ~190px-wide solid teal annulus (visible from x≈30-1050, y≈250-1210) whose interior is filled with dense hairline striations; at poster scale those striations alias into a moiré-like woven band instead of crisp chart linework, and the band's sheer mass flattens the 'fine concentric rings' idea into a single heavy donut. The previous revision's aliased full-field rings are gone, but the fix overshot into a mechanical solid band.

The annulus is concentric with the frame centre (≈540,730), not with the bottle as ping source: its inner mint hole frames the black cap and shoulders (y≈446-660) while the slab's vertical mass centre sits at y≈893, so the echo reads as a halo behind the cap and the lower body sinks into the solid band. The brief's 'source of the ping' geometry is still not true; the ring system and the object remain two stacked centres.

The subtitle line 'EAU DE TOILETTE' (y 259-279) now sits directly on the annulus's upper striated band, so wide-tracked dark teal type competes with busy hairline texture behind it (visible across x≈374-703); the monument band loses the clean matte ground it had in the previous revision. The teal tick at y≈312 also lands inside the band's top edge, further muddying the stack's closing mark.

Contact is verified present in the detail crop (soft elliptical shadow hugging the base plinth within crop [276,1199,805,1440], offset_y 0 correct), but the ring system still never acknowledges the contact point: no ring terminates at, touches or emanates from the base at y=1339, while references 3-5 each bind object to field through caustics, reflection or shadow direction. Product and chart coexist; the 'ping' narrative stops at the halo.

changes.value: Seamless flat matte chart paper in pale glacier mint, only five to seven widely spaced crisp single-weight concentric circles in deep marine teal expanding from the exact center of the frame, generous empty mint between each circle, one slightly thicker clean circle at mid radius, no dense hatching, no moire, no banding, circles fading out before the canvas edges, perfectly even shadowless illumination, no texture gradients, no objects
